annotations.title: List the types of business for the AI receptionist

description: Lists the types of business an AI receptionist can start from (clinics and dentists, salons, restaurants, tours, online shops, real estate, education, any other business): each one’s key, what it fills in the persona, its procedures, its typical services, the urgent words that pass a chat to a person, its closed message, and what a receptionist of that type may do (a clinic only books). Read-only.
